column2: That deep? Down there names weigh more. If you brought any up, I'll buy them.
Full satchel, eh? The Shadows of the Market are already sniffing the air. Come to me before they come to you.
Every time you climb back up, the valley remembers you a little better. And memory, my friend, has a price.
{c} hasn't spoken since you came back. I've seen that look in war. Let time do its work.
{c} shines with a strange light. Something down there lit a strength in that heart that you don't have.
The Cult will come for the Bertoldo children. Reach floor {floor} of {biome} to break their rite.
The Cult came in the night. The Bertoldo farm is empty, and no one looks you in the eye anymore.
Tomas falls into the light without a cry. The portal closes over him like a mouth. Kael stays on his knees before the seal until dawn, and asks you nothing. Not yet.

As you clasp Vesper's hand, Tomas throws himself into the seal alone: Kael didn't have the courage, and you weren't there. The portal closes. Elara's child breathes. Ilyas vanishes into the smoke, in the arms of the Cult.
You stand still. You watch the portal tear Tomas from Kael's hands. You watch a figure with an eye sewn on its cloak slip away through the flames. The portal closes by itself, sated. No one saw you.
